mission.title: Propelling blockchain innovation at ÉTS.
mission.description: Blockchain technology is rapidly transforming how we interact, transact, and design digital systems. Yet, it often remains surrounded by complexity and misunderstandings.
mission.whoWeAreText: ETS Blockchain is the only student club specialized in Web3 and Blockchain technologies in Quebec. Founded in 2023, it is not just a student club: it is the decentralized technology expertise hub of École de technologie supérieure.
mission.ourVisionText: Since the emergence of Bitcoin in 2008, blockchain has proven it can redefine digital trust at scale. Our goal is to transform the complexity of this technology into concrete opportunities for the engineering student community.
mission.learningDesc: Develop Web3 expertise through technical workshops, expert conferences, and resource sharing for future engineers.
mission.networkingDesc: Connect the student community with industry leaders, major protocols, and VC funds to foster professional integration.
mission.competitionsDesc: Participate in premier global Hackathons (ETH Global, ZkHack) to design concrete and innovative decentralized solutions.

achievements.zkHackDesc: Winners of an excellence award from Novanet. A strong debut on the cryptography scene.
achievements.ethGlobalDesc: Participation in one of the world's largest Ethereum hackathons alongside top developers.
